prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1140; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the best number to reach you.

A: [Claimant name] and I can be reached at [phone number].

Q: Walk me through what happened before the collision. Where were you headed?

A: I was driving through the intersection on my way to a store on the other side of the road. I had my turn signal on and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic.

Q: Were you stopped at the time, or moving?

A: I was almost stopped. I was rolling slowly into the turn when I saw the other car coming toward me.

Q: What did you do when you saw it?

A: I tried to brake, but it was too late. The front of my car was already in the path of the other vehicle, and it hit the driver's side.

Q: Did you see the traffic light before turning?

A: The light had turned green for the through traffic, and I had a green arrow for the left turn. I believe I had the right of way, but I'm not completely sure about the timing.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I hurt my right shoulder when the airbag deployed and I was thrown against the door. It's sore, I can't lift my arm above my head comfortably, and I've been seeing a doctor about it.

Q: Did you go to the hospital or receive treatment on the scene?

A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Only that I've been careful about following the doctor's instructions, and I want to make sure my car repairs and medical bills are handled properly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
